description: README.md's '## CLI reference' table documents every user-facing tether subcommand from tether/cli.py's click definitions — init, init claude-code, add (--description), status (--json, --diff/--no-diff), show, refs, coverage (--list-untethered-files, --list-tethered-files, --json), refresh, update (--a-path, --b-path, --description), mv, rm — and excludes the intentionally hidden hook command group. Adding, removing, or renaming a subcommand in cli.py, or changing the arguments/flags the table documents, must update the README CLI reference table to match.
